title: Hancock's annual 4th of July event: Music, food, fireworks - Monadnock Ledger-Transcript
text:
The town of Hancock will hold its annual Independence Day fireworks celebration Sunday, June 28, at Moose Brook Park, 40 Bennington Road.
Gates open at 5 p.m. The event will feature live music, food vendors and fireworks at dusk.
The Hancock Depot Association will provide entertainment throughout the evening. Danielle Miraglia will perform at 5:45 p.m., followed by Rusty Bearings & the Salty Undercarriage at 6:45 p.m. Eyes of Age will take the stage at 7:45 p.m. and perform until the fireworks begin.
Food, including burgers, hot dogs, drinks and snow cones, will be available for purchase.
A suggested donation of $10 per adult is requested. Admission is free for children.
